scope: Authoring, review, and XR for frame-stage clouds in Blender and Unity. Measurement stays in Open3D (doc 02). No editor was installed.

blender_viz.pick: Point Cloud Visualizer Standard on Blender 4.5 LTS

blender_seg.pick: No segmenter. Review labels in PCV or Point Cloud I/O. Manual correction via set-scalar or Set Attribute.
blender_seg.fit: maybe for review and small edits; no for automatic stud/plate/beam labels

unity_viz.pick: Point Cloud Viewer and Tools 3, with the external converter for binary PLY and LAZ
unity_viz.fit: yes for XR review of a precolored cloud
unity_viz.price_usd: 110 on the US listing fetched 2026-09-23; tax at checkout

unity_seg.pick: No segmenter. Bake class or angle colors to RGB before import.
unity_seg.note: Toolkit segmentation is spatial culling, not semantic classes.

tools.last_activity: Docs titled 3.12 on 2026-09-23. Store lists Blender 4.2-5.2, 2400+ sales.
tools.large_cloud: Standard: hundreds of millions, RAM-bound. 8 GB GPU example ~300M points, default shader, scalars off. Pro tiles author demo 1.505e9 points.

tools.role: import and export labeled native point clouds
tools.large_cloud: Author text says million-point datasets. No out-of-core mode. LAS export quantized to 1 mm.
No published scan limit. Built-in PLY import is a mesh.
Release notes: performance is not ideal. No export.

tools.last_activity: Store listing 3.0.3 on 2026-06-10. Forum post describes v3.04.
tools.large_cloud: No official cap. Forum: 300M ASCII-path PLY failed in the editor converter.

tools.role: E57 and PTS import, LOD, display
